projects.name: Parking Lot System
projects.tech: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Object-Oriented Design
bullets: Implemented low-level object-oriented design applying Creational and Behavioral design patterns (Factory, Strategy) to manage parking spots, vehicle types, and dynamic fee calculation strategies.
Developed REST APIs to handle parking ticket issuance, vehicle check-in/checkout workflows, and real-time slot availability tracking.

projects.name: Movie Ticket Booking System
projects.tech: Java, Spring Boot, JPA, Transaction Management
bullets: Engineered a booking service with relational data modeling, handling concurrent seat reservations, show scheduling, and pricing tiers.
Utilized Spring transaction management (@Transactional) and database locking mechanisms to prevent double-booking and maintain transactional integrity.

projects.name: Expense Sharing Application
bullets: Modeled split-expense domain logic supporting multiple split strategies (equal, exact amounts, percentage) among user groups.
Exposed RESTful endpoints for group management, expense creation, and calculating consolidated balances to minimize settlement transactions.
